description: The file defines the EmployeeSkillAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, providing REST API endpoints for managing employee skills, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting employee skill records. It includes detailed Swagger annotations for API documentation, validation rules, and interacts with service and DAO layers.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPI
classes.description: Class providing REST API endpoints for managing employee skills, including CRUD operations with validation, documentation annotations, and service interactions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetch a specific employee skill by employee number and skill ID, returns a resource result or throws a not found exception.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: List all skills associated with a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new employee skill record based on request data, returns the created skill as a resource.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing employee skill with provided data, returns the updated skill as a resource.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete multiple employee skills based on IDs provided in request.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Helper method to create or update an EmployeeSkill entity from request data.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring employee number is accessible.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for fetching a single skill.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a skill.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a skill.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Common validation rules for request body when creating or updating skills.
